annotations.title: Meme coin ticker / name availability check

description: FREE, no API key (about 100 calls/day). Checks whether a meme coin ticker symbol or name is already used on Solana (DexScreener-indexed tokens, pump.fun included) or in the JestSprout gallery, before you launch. Lists matching mints with liquidity and creation date.

name.description: Optional coin name, e.g. Moon Frog

ticker.description: Ticker symbol, with or without $, e.g. FROG
